fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects AnyDesk Remote Desktop silent installation. Which can be used by attackers to gain remote access.
fields.name: Remote Access Tool - AnyDesk Silent Installation
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "--install" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "--start-with-win" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "--silent"))
